deferred.name: typescript
deferred.reason: typescript-eslint (under eslint-config-next) accepts <6.1.0 until its 7.1 native-parser support lands (typescript-eslint#12803), and 7.0 publishes no JS API, which test/apiReport.ts uses; 6.0.3 is installed meanwhile

deferred.name: @babel/core
deferred.reason: under Babel 8 the React Compiler silently skips components with defaults in destructured parameters (react#37406, open), and the editor's build runs it through @rolldown/plugin-babel

deferred.name: @types/node
deferred.reason: the types follow the Node we run: 24 locally, in CI and on Vercel. Node 26 is LTS since 2026-10-28 and Vercel's default; moving means nvm, both workflows' node-version and the Vercel project's setting (or engines) together

acceptedAdvisories.reason: deepmerge 4.3.1 has no fixed version; only the shadcn CLI and @shadcn/registry 0.2.1 use it, merging a registry item's theme we chose into our own config, in dev. Watch @shadcn/registry for a release without it

keptUnmaintained.reason: stable 1.0.0, maintained in the React repository
